messages:
sara: Quick follow-up from yesterday's outage where the fallback chain and KV cache eviction interacted badly. We promised concrete test additions and owners in the postmortem. dropping proposed owners/timelines here.

michael: I can take the regression-suite work. plan: add a fallback-matrix job that runs q8/q4 + baseline FP16 variants across seq lengths 128/512/2048, and a smoke to assert fallback latency SLOs. ETA 8 business days. creating INF-4201.

jess: I'll author the promptset derived from production traces + a few adversarial truncation cases. goal: 20-30 prompts split into 3 eval buckets (prod-fail, truncation, latency-sensitive). PR to evals repo by Thurs. INF-4203.

kevin: I'll own load/chaos. proposed schedule: one dry-run chaos drill next Wed 02:00-03:00 UTC (KV eviction + small GPU throttling), then 2 larger drills over next month. INF-4205. need infra approval for window.

oncall-bot: Created follow-up INF-4200: Postmortem actions for fallback cascade. Assignees: michael, jess, kevin. https://rwinf/INF-4200

sara: couple of specifics: 1) regression CI should run on a dedicated-capacity fixture so we mimic production routing. 2) add alerting for fallback-error-rate and fallback-latency regression. 3) tests must include scenario where prefix-cache invalidation occurs mid-request.

michael: ack. will add a dedicated-capacity label to the job and a small harness that can replay a cached-kv-miss during a stream. putting a baseline artifact in the ticket.

jess: for promptsets: I'll include the exact customer convo that failed (redacted) and a synthetic that reproduces the token-shift pattern. linking draft: https://github.com/redwood/evals/pull/790 (wip).

kevin: on alerting: propose new alert rule: sum(increase(fallback_errors[5m])) / sum(increase(requests[5m])) > 0.005 AND p95(fallback_latency) > 300ms. I'll add to infra alerts repo. also adding runbook steps in the postmortem doc.

sara: ownership/timeline recap: regression CI (michael) - 8 business days, promptset PR (jess) - Thu, chaos drill dry-run (kevin) - next Wed. I'll track in the postmortem and mark weekly check-ins.

michael: small ci snippet I'll add to INF-4201: ```yaml
jobs:
  fallback-matrix:
    runs-on: self-hosted-dedicated
    strategy:
      matrix:
        variant: [q8, q4, fp16]
        seq: [128,512,2048]
    steps:
      - run: ./tools/run_fallback_test.sh --variant ${{ matrix.variant }} --seq ${{ matrix.seq }}
```

jess: added a TODO in evals: map prompt buckets to automated nightly runs so we catch regressions early. linking tests to CI ticket once merged.

kevin: scheduling note: infra has tentatively approved Wed window. I'll post calendar invite and blackout rules. also will coordinate with oncall to have a point of contact.

oncall-bot: INF-4200 updated by sara at 1771001330

sara: thanks team. final ask: when you land artifacts, update the postmortem checklist with reproduce steps, verification steps (what pass looks like), owners, and a note for PM sign-off. meeting to review progress in 7 days. :thumbsup:
